title: Noise-Directed Adaptive Remapping for Integer Optimization: from qubits to (encoded) qudits
summary: We extend Noise-Directed Adaptive Remapping (NDAR), a recently proposed heuristic meta-algorithm that leverages device noise as a computational resource, to optimization problems over discrete (integer) domains. While originally introduced for unconstrained binary optimization, the proposed generalization introduces additional gauge degrees of freedom at the logical level, such that the gauge transformation applied at each iteration is no longer unique, allowing tailoring to particular encodings or quantum hardware.
